proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ G X Z hG hX hZ hZm
  constructor
  · intro h A hA
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_ae (hG A hA) (h.mono fun ω hω _ => hω), MeasureTheory.setIntegral_condExp hG hX hA]
  · intro h
    exact MeasureTheory.ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq hG hX (fun A _ _ => hZ.integrableOn) (fun A hA _ => h A hA) hZm.aestronglyMeasurable
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (G : MeasurableSpace Ω) (X Z : Ω → ℝ), G ≤ m0 → MeasureTheory.Integrable X P → MeasureTheory.Integrable Z P → @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ G Z → (Z =ᵐ[P] (MeasureTheory.condExp G P (X)) ↔ ∀ A, @MeasurableSet Ω G A → ∫ ω in A, Z ω ∂P = ∫ ω in A, X ω ∂P)
